text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- PM bets on familiar faces: Cabinet choices show Chretien's reluctance to part with old, make room for new.
- Canada still place to live, UN says: Best in world 4th year in a row.
- McLellan assigned pivotal cabinet jobs: Albertan takes over as Justice Minister, will work on four key committees.
- Bre-X report reveals legal fund for officers.
- We're retiring sooner, report says: Statscan says median age is now just over 62, two and a half years earlier than 15 years ago.
- Ukraine's PM dogged by corrupt image: Lazarenko's trip to Canada seeks to dispel rumors, attract wary investors.
- Bre-X report reveals legal fund: C$5-million trust set up last December to help executives defray costs, monitor says.
- Rogers proclaims cable-computer alliance: CEOs discuss building device to bring TV, Internet to home.
- Inco sells alloys business: Division fetches C$410-million from U.S. merchant bank.
- Black fine-tunes Southam bid, but won't boost price: Says those who want more are 'greedy.'
- Hollinger amends offer: But investors say rejigged Southam bid is nothing more than tinkering and no real improvement on original C$23.50-a-share offer.
- Rogers expects U.S. investor will take equity stake.
- Parmalat chief leaves door open for sweetened Ault bid.
